robots.description: Kengo is Galaxea Dynamics’ self-developed bipedal humanoid robot, unveiled June 2, 2026. Built with just two core actuator modules across the entire joint system, Kengo combines mass-production-ready hardware with Galaxea’s embodied AI brain and high-performance motion engine. The robot delivers over 130 N·m of joint torque, withstands repeated falls and impacts, and targets industrial manufacturing, commercial services, and everyday home life. Made in Beijing by one of China’s newer humanoid robotics unicorns.
